name: dyn_err_set_not_state
source:
DYNAMIC badset (method = ode45, time = 0 .. 10, points = 3)
  der(Level) = 1
  Level(0) = 0
  Aux = 2*Level
  EVENT trip: Level = 4 | rising -> set Aux = 0
END

error.message: EVENT trip: set target 'aux' is not a state of this DYNAMIC block — only der(...) states can be reassigned at an event.
